description: Implementation of the QuicEndpointBase class and QuicEndpointMultiplexer for QUIC protocol simulation, including packet handling, address generation, and trace recording.

classes.name: QuicEndpointBase
classes.description: Represents a network endpoint in QUIC simulation, handling packet transmission, reception, and tracing.

classes.name: QuicEndpointBase::Writer
classes.description: Handles writing packets from the endpoint, managing write blocking and packet size constraints.

classes.name: QuicEndpointMultiplexer
classes.description: Manages multiple QuicEndpointBase instances, routing packets to the correct endpoint based on destination.

methods.name: HashNameIntoFive32BitIntegers
methods.description: Hashes a string name into five 32-bit integers using SHA-1.

methods.name: GetAddressFromName
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random IP address and port based on a name hash.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::DropNextIncomingPacket
methods.description: Flags the endpoint to drop the next incoming packet.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::RecordTrace
methods.description: Starts recording trace information for the endpoint.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::AcceptPacket
methods.description: Processes an incoming packet if addressed to this endpoint.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::SetTxPort
methods.description: Sets the transmission port for the endpoint.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::OnPacketDequeued
methods.description: Handles logic when a packet is dequeued from the transmission queue.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::Writer::WritePacket
methods.description: Attempts to write a packet, blocking if the queue is full.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::Writer::IsWriteBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the writer is currently blocked.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::Writer::GetMaxPacketSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum packet size supported.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::Writer::SupportsReleaseTime
methods.description: Indicates whether release time support is available.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::Writer::IsBatchMode
methods.description: Indicates whether batch mode is supported.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::Writer::GetNextWriteLocation
methods.description: Provides the next write location buffer.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::Writer::Flush
methods.description: Flushes the writer, completing any pending writes.

methods.name: QuicEndpointMultiplexer::AcceptPacket
methods.description: Routes an incoming packet to the appropriate endpoint based on destination.

methods.name: QuicEndpointMultiplexer::SetTxPort
methods.description: Sets the transmission port for all managed endpoints.
